**Enterprise**
- [ ] Submit a [Separation Employee Request Form (SERF)](https://atx.servicenowservices.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item_guide&sys_id=72fb6289db9f73405b03f482ba961956) or, if the team member will remain at the City, a [Transfer Employee Request Form (TERF)](https://atx.servicenowservices.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item_guide&sys_id=b714eb12db7a3f0021ccef92ca961972&sysparm_category=2e9b37dc1b8016d03d9c404fe54bcba1). These cover the following:
           - Network Email
           - Enterprise licenses including Miro, 1Password, etc. 
           - Badge & Building Access
           - Absolute Secure Access (NetMotion)

**DTS Admin**
- [ ] Remove team member from [DTS Orientation Slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1ByRWXmjHut88cTiPVOTgkwTJ2V5_m1Y_0j46FP_kdYw/edit#slide=id.gfd25a7f266_1_382) 
- [ ] Reassign [open Github issues](https://github.com/cityofaustin/atd-data-tech/issues) 
- [ ] Move team member to "Alumni" section on Austinmobility.io _About Us_ page
